nodes.summary: For a bipartite graph with $n$ rows and $n$ columns given by a relation $B$, the number of perfect matchings, taken modulo $2$, is the determinant over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ of the 0-1 biadjacency matrix. Its parity is thus computable in polynomial time, although counting the perfect matchings exactly is $\#P$-complete.
nodes.title: Parity of the number of bipartite perfect matchings

nodes.summary: For every square integer matrix $M$, the residue of $\operatorname{per} M$ modulo $2$ is the determinant of the reduction of $M$ modulo $2$, computed over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$. So the permanent modulo $2$ is computable in polynomial time, by Gaussian elimination.
nodes.title: The permanent of an integer matrix modulo 2 is its determinant modulo 2

nodes.title: The 0-1 permanent counts perfect matchings

nodes.summary: Over a commutative ring of characteristic $2$, the permanent of every square matrix equals its determinant, since every sign $\pm 1$ equals $1$.
nodes.title: Permanent equals determinant in characteristic two

nodes.summary: The function that sends a bitstring encoding a square 0-1 matrix to its permanent, and every other bitstring to $0$, is $\#P$-complete.
nodes.title: The permanent is #P-complete (Valiant)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
